description: NaSn₂(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3c space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.48 Å. Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.04 Å) and three longer (2.07 Å) Sn-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-39°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sn and one P atom.
